caption: The drawing depicts a single agricultural tool, specifically a plow, shown in two views. The main object is a detailed, colored rendering of the plow, which features a curved wooden handle that transitions into a broad, flat, metal blade at the bottom. The handle is brown with visible wood grain texture, while the metal blade is depicted in a darker brown, suggesting rust or aged metal. The plow's base is trapezoidal and appears solid, resting on the surface. Near the top right of the composition, there is a simplified, black line drawing of the same plow, showing its shape and structure with minimal detail. The background is plain and off-white, with the artist’s signature, “Lloyd Charles Lowcock 1938,” written in small, cursive script to the left of the center. There are faint annotations and numbers along the left margin near the bottom edge.
title: Adze
